content.comment_body: Today, I upgraded to [product_name] [version_no] and everything works well on Sonoma 14.1.2. My hardware is [version_no]. When I run /usr/libexec/java_home, it returns /Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/jdk1.8.0_144.jdk/Contents/Home. However, after the first launch, I encounter several Java runtime errors. My question is: which Java runtime is officially supported for [product_name] [version_no]?
This information is provided in the online help of [product_name] [version_no].

Thanks. Here is a link for Java Runtime V11: [url]. [company_name] [product_name] uses the x86_64 architecture and is not universal. Therefore, users with Apple Silicon Macs should download the x86_64 version of Java Runtime Version 11 from the link above.

analysis.insight_summary: Users upgrading to the latest [product_name] version encounter Java runtime errors on MacOS Sonoma, due to compatibility issues between required and installed Java versions. The lack of clear information within the application about supported Java runtimes leads users to consult external documentation and community advice for solutions, highlighting the need for improved in-software guidance.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] [version_no] to run smoothly on MacOS with clear instructions regarding compatible Java versions and supported processor architectures.
